title: Poison Darts
description: This plugin adds 4 special poisons which can be harvested from frogs and combined to make the final poison.
body:
Poison Dart Frogs are living weapons. Capture them in bowls, load them into blowpipes, and fire poison darts at your enemies. Each frog carries a unique venom. Combine any two blowpipes to create **Hemotoxin**, the ultimate poison.

## Frogs

| Variant | Poison |
|----------|----------|
| Temperate | Entangle |
| Cold | Numbness |
| Warm | Heat Fever |

Frogs are immune to all poison effects.

## Features

- Capture frogs in bowls
- Release or lick captured frogs
- Drag the bowl onto Bamboo
- Poison cloud aura system
- Blowpipes with ammo and cooldowns
- Four unique poison types
- Hemotoxin blowpipe crafting
- Cross-plugin poison effect support
